name: Beechcraft Model 18
summary: Twin-radial light transport built 1937–1970, used as a military trainer/transport, airliner and freighter; many fly as vintage aircraft.

wings: Low wing with tapered outer panels
engines: Two round radial engines in short nacelles
fuselage: Tailwheel gear; sits nose-high on the ground
Streamlined fuselage with a row of round-cornered windows
tail: Twin oval fins and rudders at the ends of the horizontal tail

tellTales: Twin radial engines with twin oval tail fins
Taildragger stance with the nose pointing up

confusedWith.howToTell: The B-25 is much larger with a shoulder-mounted gull wing, tricycle gear and a glazed or gun nose; the Beech 18 is a low-wing taildragger.
The DC-3 is far larger with a single tall fin; the Beech 18 has twin oval fins.
